prompt:
Create a NEW ORIGINAL high-detail atlas of SIX truly disassembled Chinese building structure PARTS, a regular 3 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS grid. Highest-resolution landscape 3:2 canvas, ideally 1536x1024 or larger. TRUE TRANSPARENT background outside all six separate objects, generous 12% cell gutters, complete shapes, no overlap, no text/labels/grid/ground/shadow/halo. NOT whole buildings, NOT intact rooms, NO roofs, no compositions of multiple props. Premium hand-painted pre-rendered realism with extremely fine material grain, joints and restrained edge wear; neutral upper-left lighting, natural colors, crisp clear alpha, no toy or low-poly shapes.
All first FOUR assets are small FLAT RECTANGULAR SURFACE PATCHES viewed perfectly FRONT-ON ORTHOGRAPHIC, no perspective, no top or side faces. Exact clean rectangular edges and uniform rectangular scale. Each is one modest wall SECTION about 2 metres wide by 2.4 metres tall, not a whole house facade. No windows or doors or pillars attached, no foundation, no roof. Interior texture fine, evenly distributed, avoid huge distinctive cracks or dramatic shadows; useful as repeatable wall pieces.
ROW1:
1 wall_earth: rectangular warm ochre RAMMED EARTH wall section, subtle horizontal tamped layers, minute grain and restrained weathering, understated realistic packed soil material, absolutely no timber framing or roof.
2 wall_plaster: rectangular pale warm WHITE LIME PLASTER wall section, delicate hand-trowelled surface, tiny irregular pores, slight gentle wear at edges, no opening or trim or shadow gradient, useful to build Chinese courtyard houses.
3 wall_timber: rectangular vertical aged ELM PLANK wall section, five or six straight close-fit narrow boards with fine seams and realistic longitudinal timber grain, restrained nails, no surrounding frame, no roof.
ROW2:
4 wall_brick: rectangular warm-grey fired BRICK wall section, detailed small masonry courses with restrained thin mortar lines, authentic old Chinese grey brick, no border, no foundation or roof, not large toy bricks.
5 brace_wood: ONE isolated straight diagonal wooden BRACE timber. Front-on orthographic flat timber face, sloping bottom-left to top-right at 45 degrees, detailed grain running along its length and small mortise end cuts, no other beams attached. Slender length:width about 6:1, complete timber, not a whole triangular truss.
6 dougong: ONE SMALL self-contained traditional Chinese wooden DOUGONG BRACKET cluster, about three interlocking curved bracket arms and modest small blocks, warm weathered elm, exquisite delicate joinery, 2:1 dimetric three-quarter view. NO pillar below, NO beam extending sideways, NO roof above, NO wall. Just this small bracket component as one isolated prop.
Six independent parts only. Respect the distinction between FRONT-ON wall material faces and the isolated small dimensional bracket. These parts will be assembled by code, so never preassemble a house, room, whole roof or wall with fittings.
originality: Fresh original generation for this project; no old architecture or third-party game images used as input.
